افتقدن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَقَدْنَ (iftaqadna) /if.ta.qad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اُفْتُقِدْنَ (uftuqidna) /uf.tu.qid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اِفْتَقِدْنَ (iftaqidna) /if.ta.qid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
